tagline.en: Hosted access to Luma's Ray2 text-to-video and image-to-video generation, via your own API key.
tagline.zh: 以自备 API key 的方式接入 Luma Ray2 的文生视频与图生视频生成服务。

en: Luma Ray2 is Luma Labs' video-generation model, offered here as a hosted service through WorldFoundry's Studio pipeline. Rather than running weights locally, you send prompts to Luma's cloud service, which generates the video and returns it.

It handles both text-to-video and image-to-video: provide a text prompt, optionally an image, and it produces a clip. As a hosted service, there is nothing to download and no GPU to manage on your side.
zh: Luma Ray2 是 Luma Labs 的视频生成模型,这里以托管服务的形式通过 WorldFoundry 的 Studio pipeline 提供。你无需在本地运行权重,而是把提示词发送到 Luma 的云端服务,由其生成视频并返回。
它同时支持文生视频与图生视频:提供一段文本提示词、可选再加一张图片,它便产出一段片段。作为托管服务,你这边无需下载任何东西,也无需管理 GPU。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want Luma's video generation without provisioning local hardware, and are comfortable calling a cloud service through an API key.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想使用 Luma 的视频生成、又不想配置本地硬件,并愿意通过 API key 调用云端服务时,可以使用它。

notFor.en: You must provide your own provider API key, and output quality, availability, and cost all depend on the external service rather than on WorldFoundry.
notFor.zh: 你需要自备服务商 API key,且输出质量、可用性与费用均取决于外部服务,而非 WorldFoundry。

en: Hosted service — no local weights or GPU needed
Text-to-video and image-to-video in one endpoint
Requires your own provider API key
zh: 托管服务——无需本地权重或 GPU
同一入口支持文生视频与图生视频
需自备服务商 API key
